top_signals.title: KBW CEO on Re-Building Manhattan After 9/11
top_signals.summary: Tom Michaud describes how KBW responded in the aftermath of Sept. 11 by focusing first on helping the families of victims and then on rebuilding the firm. He speaks with Tyler Kendall Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: SL Green CFO on Lower Manhattan's Rebound After 9/11
top_signals.summary: Matt DiLiberto discussed the 25-year transformation of Lower Manhattan after Sept. 11, saying the area has been “reimagined” from a largely nine-to-five financial district into a vibrant neighborhood where people live, work, study, and visit. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
